verdict.rationale: iTerm2's generative AI features ship as an optional, separately installed plugin, designed so terminal data cannot accidentally go over the network. The built-in LLM chat only reads terminal contents when you link a session. Community reports say AI is off by default, uses your own API key with no account login, can point at a configurable API URL (e.g. local Ollama), and sends nothing until you type a question. Claims that it sent data without a key were traced to an invalid key. One user complained the older 'unconfigured' state was not a clear off toggle, which the plugin separation now addresses. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of exactly what session data each AI request transmits, a documented explicit in-app disable toggle, and first-party docs (not just community) confirming no login is required.
